fusions.name: Gaff Finish
fusions.desc: Consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to this blow, which deals 14 damage. It only strikes a target at or below 25% health. For 4 seconds afterwards you move 20% faster.

fusions.name: Reel In
fusions.desc: Casts a barbed line that deals 12 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. You rush up to 5 tiles to the target.

fusions.name: Haul Line
fusions.desc: A challenge that pulls up to 5 enemies within 8 tiles onto you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Set the Barb
fusions.desc: Against a target carrying one of your afflictions, you deal 10% more damage. Your armour rises by 6%.
